thread:
Tara: FYI ACME Health POC is stalled — their CISO flagged two blockers: customer-managed KMS/ekm attestation + a written latency SLA (p95 <200ms) at 3k rps for the POC. They said they'll only proceed if we commit to dedicated capacity. @priya-vp-sales can you weigh in on pricing exception? cc @mike-se
Mike-SE: Technically doable but depend on model & seq length. Dedicated pool + aggressive KV/prefix cache should hit p95 targets for short sequences. Need load shape + exemplar prompts. Also if they require EKM with HSM calls, expect ~10-15% throughput hit.
Samops: Heads-up: dedicated GPU pools are near capacity next 10 business days. Typical lead time to reserve & provision is ~7-10 biz days + infra approval. If exec signs we can prioritize but still an ETA.
Zoe-legal: I got the security questionnaire (120 Qs) and a copy of their DPA. I'll start review but need clarification on key ownership and egress obligations. Who's owning answers for the KMS flow?
Priya-vp-sales: Revenue context — this is a strategic healthcare account (CCB potential). I'm open to a one-off POC concession if the tech/ops ask is reasonable. @finance please model a POC discount + a dedicated instance add-on. We'll need an exec sign-off to bend standard terms.
Jeff-eng: For numbers: p95 <200ms @3k rps is doable if median seq ~128 tokens and we use batching + cache. If they stream long chats (>=512 tokens) it's much harder. Can someone confirm expected token distribution? Also posting a warmup k6 script we use for perf runs: https://internal.tools/k6/acme-poc-load (proto).
Tara: They provided an example corpus — avg 140 tokens, bursts to 512 on complex queries. Uploading their questionnaire + load CSV to the folder: https://redwood.share/acme/poc-uploads (permissions: sales-team).
Mike-SE: Proposed mitigation: 1) Dedicated reserved pool (4x A100 equiv) 2) Prefix/KV cache for common prompts 3) Quantized model variant as fallback during peaks 4) Network egress peering to their region. If they insist on EKM/HSM we should run a perf test because calls per-token to KMS will add latency.
deploy-bot: cluster-request created: dedicated-acme-poc by tara — provisioning ETA placeholder 2026-05-10T18:30:00Z (will update once infra ticket is triaged).
Samops: I'm opening INFRA-5278 (high) to request dedicated reservation + infra budget tag. Will notify once we have hard ETA.
Zoe-legal: Also flagged: they want read access to audit logs for the POC and SOC2 evidence. I'll request SOC2 scope docs and last pentest report.
Priya-vp-sales: Let's get an exec bridge with the customer's CTO + CISO TOMORROW 09:00 PT to unblock approval. Tara please send invite and a 10-slide one-pager: risk mitigations, cost delta, timeline. Mike-se own the SOW appendix for DEDICATED POC config. Zoe-legal own questionnaire answers for KMS flow. Samops own infra ETA. Finance to propose pricing by EOD.
Tara: On it. Scheduling now. Will include a short runbook for the perf demo and owner list.
Mike-SE: I'll prep a 2-slide perf summary + test plan. Plan to run a synthetic load with the customer's sample corpus and show p95/throughput tradeoffs.
Jeff-eng: If we need to show worst-case numbers quickly I can run a small local perf test with quantized variant + EKM shim to show delta; should have numbers in 24h.
Tara: Thanks all — once exec call is confirmed I'll drop the calendar link here. :thumbsup:
(added reaction: :white_check_mark: by priya-vp-sales)
